notes.title: DID YOU KNOW? - Special Weapon Showcase
notes.content:
Weapons Showcase


In Drunkonauts, danger comes in many forms.

Some weapons are designed to control other players. Others are made to disrupt the fight completely.

 

If you can cause chaos, you can win.

 

Today, we focus on two weapons that bring new types of chaos.

Choose your favorite 👇




[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586596/9c0e2b98380d042bb5cd9445e26d26f35df12c16.png"]
The Champagne


Celebrate… or sabotage?



🍾 Pop it open and watch your friends lose balance.

🫧 The floor becomes slippery.

🎉 It’s fun, chaotic, and a little embarrassing.



Best for players who enjoy turning the floor into a hazard.





[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586596/400ab297c609569d17eb3dd195366ea5fca96edd.png"]
The Extinguisher


 Put out fires, or start some trouble.



🆘 Safety tool turned into a weapon.

😵‍💫 Useful for escaping or creating confusion.

🚨 Not subtle, but always effective.



Best for players who want safety and control.

 






In Drunkonauts, danger comes in many forms.
Not every weapon is about damage. Some control the fight in other ways.

 

Would you choose a slippery trap or a cloud of smoke?

🍾 Champagne — slippery chaos

🧯 Extinguisher — smoky disruption

 

Every choice changes how you play. Pick the one that fits your playstyle.

notes.title: DID YOU KNOW? - Weapon Showcase
notes.content:
Weapons Showcase

In Drunkonauts, almost anything can be a weapon. If you swing it hard enough.
Some tools are made to fix things. Others are made to cause problems.

If you can hold it, you can throw it.

Today, we’re looking at two simple items that hit harder than they should. Choose your favorite 👇


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586596/2aa7972508824ea661c84ae0187703f3bc1a9b1b.png"]
The Sawblade

Fast and sharp. Totally unsafe.

🪽 This blade isn’t attached to anything, it’s just meant to fly.
💨 It’s lightweight, fast, and very satisfying to land a hit with.
❓ Just don’t ask where it came from.

The ultimate “don’t think, just throw” weapon.
Best for players who enjoy danger as much as victory.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586596/93294436d4031beab9a57271bed2926202e0c50e.png"]
The Shovel

Simple. Heavy. Effective.

✅ 0% subtle, 100% gets the job done.
🪦 You can dig your own grave with it... or someone else’s.
🎯 You can also throw it to surprise your opponents.

Sometimes simple is best.
For players who want one tool for all problems.




In Drunkonauts, any object can be dangerous.

Not all of them explode. Some just… hurt a lot.

Would you use the spinning blade or the heavy shovel?
🌀 Sawblade — fast and wild
🪏 Shovel — strong and simple

Simple tools still work in space. Pick the one that fits your playstyle.




🚀 Stay tuned for more deep dives into the weird and wonderful world of Drunkonauts.

notes.title: Demo & Trailer Updates
notes.content:
Let's talk about some serious stuff

Hey everyone! Enchanted Crafts Studios team here, with a quick status update as we continue developing Drunkonauts and get closer to releasing the gameplay trailer and Steam Demo.

We've been working hard on many parts of the game; new maps, weapons, jetpacks, items, and game modes. You will see many of them soon in the trailer!



We also want to share some news about how we’ll continue building the community and collecting feedback after the Steam demo goes live.

We’re preparing playtest sessions that will include exclusive content not available in the Steam demo. These playtests will help us see how new ideas and gameplay elements perform before they are fully added to the game. They will only be available to a small group of players at a time.

To help this process, we’re also launching an official Discord server, where players can hang out, give feedback, and join future community events.

Both the playtests and the Discord server will go live after the Steam demo is released.



If you want to be part of the first wave of playtesters or get notified when Discord opens, we recommend to subscribe to our newsletter  💌




🎮 TL;DR: what to expect
A more polished Steam demo compared to the Itch.io version

Playtest sessions with exclusive content not in the Steam demo

A new community Discord server launching after the Steam demo

notes.title: DID YOU KNOW? - Weapon Showcase
notes.content:
Weapons Showcase


In Drunkonauts, almost anything can be a weapon. If you swing it hard enough.
Some tools are made to fix things. Others are made to cause problems.
You can swing them, throw them, or just cause a lot of chaos.

Today, we’re looking at two simple weapons; no effects, they just hit hard.
Choose your favorite 👇


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586596/1fae0197cd56a19307ffd7b6f32fe1d8f96eb8ad.png"]
The Toolbox
Why not hit them with the whole toolbox?
🧰 Not elegant. Just effective.
🤕 You can swing it or throw it - either way, it hurts.
💥 It looks slow but hits very hard.
This is not a weapon made for style — it’s made to win fights.
Perfect for players who think the best solution is “everything at once.”


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586596/88cbea21fd56a5688c2c106efe3ff0d0eeae0a68.png"]
The Crowbar
Simple. Fast. Reliable. And dangerous.
📦 Not just for opening crates.
🛠️ Classic tool with a new purpose.
💨 Surprisingly aerodynamic when thrown.
It does not look scary, but it gets the job done.
It's the ultimate “I just found this behind the space station” weapon.



In Drunkonauts, even simple tools can become a good weapon.
Not all of them explode. Some just… hurt a lot.



Hit with the whole box, or fast and precise hits?
🧰 Toolbox — heavy, strong, and full of tools
🛠️ Crowbar — fast, simple, and easy to throw
Everything can be a weapon. Pick the one that fits your playstyle.


🚀 Stay tuned for more deep dives into the weird and wonderful world of Drunkonauts.
And don't forget to wishlist on Steam! 👇

notes.title: DID YOU KNOW? - JETPACKS 101
notes.content:
JETPACKS 101
In Drunkonauts, jetpacks aren’t optional. They’re your best friend and worst idea at the same time.
Jetpacks help you escape danger, surprise your friends, and fly in style. 😎

Fly above traps, confuse your friends, or make a fast getaway.



New Jetpack styles, same chaos.
Choose your favorite👇

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586596/c2b533897fce8f8c0acf13a293b6c4875cd10ef8.png"]
The Soaper
Squeaky clean chaos. 🫧
Fun? Always.
🫧 Blows soap bubbles instead of flames.
✨ Style points: 10/10.
🫣 Dignity points: 0/10.
No one takes you seriously. That’s the point.
Perfect for players who want to annoy friends and confuse enemies.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586596/df2180dd792007cf95365b34c344d3b0619c6e72.png"]
The Turbo Fan
Big fan energy. Literally.
🌀 Giant fan engine on your back.
🚀 Makes take-offs look like rocket launches.
🔊 Extra loud and extra dramatic.
The subtle option? Never heard of it.
Friends will hear you before they see you.
This one is for astronauts who want all eyes on them.


In Drunkonauts, style is half the battle.
Whether you’re keeping it squeaky clean with The Soaper or going extra loud with The Turbo Fan, your jetpack says a lot about how you fight.



Turbo Fan or Bubble Jetpack? Pick your poison.
💨 Turbo Fan — Loud, powerful, impossible to ignore.
🫧 Bubble Jetpack — Silly, soapy, just plain fun.



🚀 Stay tuned for more deep dives into the weird and wonderful world of Drunkonauts.
And don't forget to wishlist on Steam! 👇

notes.title: DID YOU KNOW? - JETPACKS 101
notes.content:
JETPACKS 101


In Drunkonauts, jetpacks aren’t optional. They’re your way out, your way up, and your way into trouble. And maybe the way to show off a little too.
From dodging slowing goo to outsmart your friends on an alien jungle map, mastering your pack means mastering the chaos.


They're flashy, unpredictable, and full of personality.
Two of the jetpack styles. Same chaos. Choose your favorite 👇

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586596/860c90d46b88325ded0c8c41fd3bbca482a6481d.png"]
The Classic

It's clean and reliable. The jetpack everyone recognizes.
⚙️ It doesn’t sparkle. It doesn’t fizz. It just works.
✨ The one you grew up dreaming about.
Don’t let the basic look fool you.
If you’re the kind of player who lets your skills do the talking, this one's for you.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586596/a6202b4fc2e20188620bf66d332fe5b1c9bdbd59.png"]
The Bubbler

Two beer bottles. One jetpack. Zero dignity.
🍻 100% party fuel. 0% safety regulations.
🫧 Engineered by someone with a hangover and a dream.
Why settle for “cool” when you can rocket around like you borrowed your fuel from the fridge?
Perfect for slipping out of a fight with style or crashing into one with zero regrets. Because why not fly with carbonated confidence?


In Drunkonauts, style is half the battle.

Whether you’re keeping it clean with The Classic or going full chaos with The Bubbler, your jetpack says a lot about how you bring the heat to the battlefield.


We want to know,
What’s your jetpack style?
🧑🏻‍🚀 The Classic – Clean, cool, and chaos-ready
🫧 The Bubbler – Fizzy, loud, and a little unhinged


🚀 Stay tuned for more deep dives into the weird and wonderful world of Drunkonauts.
And don't forget to wishlist on Steam! 👇

notes.title: Jetpacks, Vibes, and a Very Cool Nomination 🎉
notes.content:
Award Nomination + Demo Progress – Things Are Getting Real

Hello, explorers! Enchanted Crafts Studios (ECS) here, bringing some exiting updates today! 

✨ What’s New
 RGA (Romanian Games Awards) Nomination — May 9, 2025 
Drunkonauts has been nominated for Best Upcoming Romanian Game at the Romanian Game Awards! Together with Nebula Developers Lab, we’ll be attending the gala on June 3rd. You can also catch part of the ECS team at Dev.Play on June 2–3.
Top community notes so far:"Lighting felt flat across maps"-> New lighting setups + better shadows on all maps“Hard to hear when I fall off the map” -> Fall sounds are now in place (gravity has a voice!)“Maps are too silent” -> Ambient VFXs and audio added for more atmosphere"Jetpack felt off sometimes”-> Thrust logic refined for smoother, more consistent behavior
🔨 What We’re Building Next
Progress on the Official Steam DemoBalancing punch cooldown for both keyboard and controllerMaking it harder to knock down yourself (unless that’s your thing)Astronauts now stand more upright (less awkward crouching)Fix for jetpack not working after first death

notes.title: Early Demo LIVE on Itch — Steam Demo Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Drunkonauts Demo Is Live – Come Break Physics With Us & Shape the Steam Release

Hello, explorers! We’re Enchanted Crafts Studios and we’re teaming up with Nebula Developers Lab to bring you Drunkonauts — a chaotic multiplayer party brawler with hilarious physics-based combat!

✨ What’s New 

Public early demo launched on Itch — April 25 2025  
Test-fly the jetpacks, throw around bottles of beer and hit your friends with crazy space weapons
Top community notes so far
"No visible indicator for the jetpack's cooldown" → Jetpack cooldown meter
"Hard to grab knocked down enemies" → Easier grab on rag-dolled foes  
"Knock down timer increases too drastically"→ A timer more balanced for more “down but not out” moments

🔨 What We’re Building Next

Late June 2025 — Official Steam Demo

 All the features from the early demo — enhanced  
 More customization options — hats, jetpacks, accessories, you name it!
 Smoother onboarding — create or join lobbies to easily play with your friends
 Better multiplayer connection — never miss a punch or a throw because of "lag" 😉

1.0 Launch — TBD — quality before calendar
